description: The frontofgoal.com page where the user can place a bet on a match or market, with the current price of the outcome they named. Use it when the user wants to bet, or asks where to bet. The link opens our site; this tool places no bet and moves no money. Spanish (es) and Portuguese (pt) pages exist for single matches.

language.description: Page language: en, es or pt.

market_id.description: The match or market: an id from find_matches, list_futures or get_market, or a frontofgoal.com page URL.

outcome.description: Optional: the outcome the user wants, e.g. "Arsenal", "Draw", "Yes" or a player's name.

name: get_trade_link

outcome.description: The outcome matched from the request.

price_cents.description: Approximate cost of one share in US cents; a share pays $1 if the outcome happens.

title: Get bet link
